text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Whoa, so cool!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That's the moment Oguri-san crossed the goal!
Her expression looks wonderful, doesn't it~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The missionary of love, Loves Only You,
let out a joyful cheer as she opened the drink bonus coaster."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Each captures a moment of pure perfection...
These coasters are truly works of art.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A weekend at Tokyo Racecourse.
Today, I was spending the day with Chrono Genesis and her peers.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Here, this is for you, Chrono-chan!
choice_data_list: Ah, you can have mine too.
Ah, I'll give you my share too.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huh, are you sure!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You always keep these in a file, right, Chrono-chan?
I figured you'd be happier with a complete set♪

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, I'll gladly take you up on that, then...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Here's mine too—please take it.
Please add it to your collection
alongside Chrono's coaster.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Curren Bouquetd'or, the kind and lovely flower, hands a coaster to Chrono Genesis.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Even you, Bouquet-san...?
Th-Thank you ve—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Wait, it's autographed!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-I'll repay you with... GⅠ-yaki! Thank you so very much...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Wah, I can't wait♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's almost time
for Gran-chan's debut race, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Yes, today's objective is the debut race
of their classmate, Gran Alegria.”

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Good Mile-ning!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The mile prodigy, Gran Alegria. She stunned the crowd
with her unique greeting and flashy entrance.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ah, found Chrono-chan and the others!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Heeeeey! Everyone, watch meee!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'll make a dominant debut fitting for the Mile Queen!
Just watch me!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Chrono-chan,
wait for me in the very front row of the winner's circle!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Oh dear~,
everyone around is looking right at Gran-chan.
choice_data_list: Sh-She's really something else in a lot of ways...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
G-Gran-chan's guts never fail
to amaze me...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Still... she certainly has the skill to back it up.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Miler!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
One length, two lengths, pulling away!
Gran Alegria crosses the finish line in first place!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Oh, an overwhelming victory...!
choice_data_list: She was coasting at the end there, wasn't she...!?
She was coasting at the end there, wasn't she...!?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
I believe the time was quite fast as well...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: A new record! Gran Alegria has just broken the Make Debut course record!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Of course! That was our goal, after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—No, even if she aimed for it,
setting a record isn't something done lightly.
Gran Alegria's ability is truly extraordinary...!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"The next debut is... Chrono-chan, right?
Follow my lead—!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Fufu, we have to give it our all too!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter?
...Um, are you concerned about that girl who placed second?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Even with a two-length lead, it was a record finish.
Closing in with a late kick right behind Gran-chan...
She must possess considerable strength herself.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "Could it be that... this might have been a 'legendary debut race'—?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: A legendary debut race?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes. A high-level debut race packed with fierce competitors is referred to as such.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: There are races where course records are shattered, fierce battles rarely seen unfold... and that turn out to be stacked with Umamusume who would all go on to win GⅠs later.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: The most famous one would probably be Buena Vista's debut race.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The winner would become the Satsuki Sho Umamusume.
Finishing 4th was the future Kikuka Sho Umamusume.
The 2nd and 5th placers went on to become graded stakes winners as well.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
And Buena Vista, who took 3rd, is a decorated
GⅠ winner herself, having won two Tiara crowns.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! So Gran-chan's Make Debut
might end up like that too.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is merely my personal speculation, but...!
However... taking history into account, it is a distinct possibility...
choice_data_list: If Chrono says so, I think it's highly likely.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Right?! I agree completely!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"If that's the case, to borrow Chrono's words—
Gran has 'carved her name into history,' hasn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, y-yes, exactly...!
We are witnessing a historic moment...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: And... in the center of it all, Gran-chan was...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah... I'm starting to shiver a little...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Somehow... it's finally sinking in
that we're really going to take the stage."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
You're right...
At last, we step into history too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sharp light gleams in Chrono Genesis and the others' eyes.
The profile of an athlete gazing upon the turf—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for you, Gran-chan.
Now, let's celebrate♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: A celebration?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Gran-chan,
congratulations on winning your debut race!

text_block_list.name: Chrono & Bouquet
text_block_list.text: Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, thanks!
I'm 120 miles full of gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah. We're going to watch the Yasuda Kinen after this, right?
Let's head over first before we eat!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
E-Everyone... are you sure about this?
Aren't you going to go watch the paddock...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"I will wait here for the photoshoot...
I'll be fine on my own, so..."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's the Yasuda Kinen, after all!
We want to watch it from a good spot too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
The Yasuda Kinen is a 1,600m GⅠ race.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I wanna see it up close
and feel all sorts of things for myself!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Um, Chrono-san, what should I be looking out for—
I was hoping to ask.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Um... They say the Tokyo 1600m turf
requires just as much stamina as a middle-distance race.

text_block_list.name: Man with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
There are two hills on this course. After clearing
the second hill on the final stretch, a 300-meter
straight follows. It takes stamina to run it all the way through.

text_block_list.name: Man in Hoodie
text_block_list.text: What's with this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...That is correct.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No.
They're just people I frequently see around the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "On the slope just before the final stretch, the pack spread out wide into a single line, turning into a scramble all the way to the finish line."

text_block_list.name: Schön Lilie
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh,
...why does victory feel so far away...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Lilie-san...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis fixated her gaze on the one who spoke—
Schön Lilie.
Her result was... 8th place.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"No, not that much...
I just happened to see you before..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It was right around after last year's Shuka Sho.
She was shouting into the hollow of a great tree...

text_block_list.name: Schön Lilie
text_block_list.text:
...*sob*, *sniff*... Waaah,
waaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Schön Lilie
text_block_list.text: Aaaaagh, waaaaahhhーー!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
She was so frustrated she couldn't put it into words...
Seeing her like that has stayed in my memory ever since...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I just can't help but be drawn to her races...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Lilie-san... placed 2nd in the Oka Sho and Shuka Sho, and 5th in the Yushun Himba (Oaks)...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Failing to claim the glory of the Tiara...
Losing by such a narrow margin must have made it—all the more frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...S-Sorry for bringing down the mood!
Today's result isn't entirely something to be pessimistic about.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Look,
the top runners are all from Lilie-san's generation...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
2nd in the NHK Mile Cup, 3rd in the Osaka Hai,
4th in the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes,
and 6th in the Mile Championship.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Everyone, we have a GⅠ winner here!
choice_data_list: I see, so your generation is stacked with talent, huh?
I see, so your generation is full of talented runners, huh?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes. They were all elites—any one of them could have taken a Classic title.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she is part of this formidable generation, then Schön Lilie, possessing strength on par with them,
also has a shot at reaching a GⅠ title.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I think the paintings by Lilie-san's generation are
almost like—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Could this be... a pointillist painting filled with countless colors?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That's so interesting!
Then what about Senpai and her generation?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, it's still only the spring of the Classic year...
We don't have enough data to discuss the generation as a whole...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye, who conquered both the Oka Sho and the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Lucky Lilac, victor of the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies, closing in on Ai.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"With you two leading the pack, people are already saying
they can't wait for your showdown against the Senior Class."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"I believe Ai-san and the others
will paint a truly grand picture..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-It's merely my own prediction, though...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: The picture drawn by a generation, huh...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I wonder what kind of picture we'd make together.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
What shall I paint on this pure white canvas—
Fufu, just thinking about it makes my heart flutter.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I've already made my first brushstroke!
With a 'Debut Race Record'!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: The portrait of a generation that we paint together...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Even among the endless scroll of history...
It would be wonderful if this became an unparalleled masterpiece...
